summary: Zeta Network Group filed a Form 6-K with six-month unaudited interim financial statements as of December 31, 2025 and June 30, 2025, covering the six months ended December 31, 2025 and 2024. The statement shows a massive increase in cryptocurrency assets to $175 million and a large jump in ordinary shares outstanding from 10,959 to 1.5 million, likely reflecting recent capital movements. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation transaction is announced or implied. The filing is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer for SEC incorporation into registration statements. No deal terms, premium, or advisor are present. This filing does not trigger a special-situation classification.
